an7.61:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā bhaggesu viharati suṃsumāragire bhesakalāvane migadāye.
an7.61:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā mahāmoggallāno magadhesu kallavālamuttagāme pacalāyamāno nisinno hoti.
an7.61:1.4: addasā kho bhagavā dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ magadhesu kallavālamuttagāme pacalāyamānaṃ nisinnaṃ.
an7.61:1.6: seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evameva bhaggesu suṃsumāragire bhesakalāvane migadāye antarahito magadhesu kallavālamuttagāme āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa pamukhe pāturahosi.
an7.61:1.8: nisajja kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ etadavoca.
an7.61:2.1: pacalāyasi no tvaṃ moggallāna, pacalāyasi no tvaṃ moggallānāti.
an7.61:2.3: tasmātiha tvaṃ moggallāna yathā saññino te viharato taṃ middhaṃ okkamati, taṃ saññaṃ mā manasākāsi. taṃ saññaṃ mā bahulamakāsi.
an7.61:2.4: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ moggallāna vijjati yaṃ te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha. (2)
an7.61:3.1: no ce te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha. tato tvaṃ moggallāna yathā sutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ cetasā anuvitakkeyyāsi, anūvicāreyyāsi, manasānupekkheyyāsi.
an7.61:3.2: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ vijjati, yaṃ te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha. (3)
an7.61:4.1: no ce te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha, tato tvaṃ moggallāna, yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena sajjhāyaṃ kareyyāsi.
an7.61:4.2: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ vijjati yaṃ te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha. (4)
an7.61:5.1: no ce te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha, tato tvaṃ moggallāna, ubho kaṇṇasotāni āviñjeyyāsi pāṇinā gattāni anumajjeyyāsi.
an7.61:5.2: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ vijjati yaṃ te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha. (5)
an7.61:6.1: no ce te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha, tato tvaṃ moggallāna, uṭṭhāyāsanā udakena akkhīni anumajjitvā disā anuvilokeyyāsi. nakkhattāni tārakarūpāni ullokeyyāsi.
an7.61:6.2: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ vijjati yaṃ te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha. (6)
an7.61:7.1: no ce te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha, tato tvaṃ moggallāna, ālokasaññaṃ manasikareyyāsi, divāsaññaṃ adhiṭṭheyyāsi.
an7.61:7.2: yathā divā tathā rattiṃ yathā rattiṃ tathā divā
an7.61:7.3: iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveyyāsi.
an7.61:7.4: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ vijjati yaṃ te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha. (7)
an7.61:8.1: no ce te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha, tato tvaṃ moggallāna, pacchāpuresaññī caṅkamaṃ adhiṭṭheyyāsi antogatehi indriyehi abahigatena mānasena.
an7.61:8.2: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ vijjati yaṃ te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha.
an7.61:9.1: no ce te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha, tato tvaṃ moggallāna dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappeyyāsi pāde pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasikaritvā.
an7.61:9.3: na seyyasukhaṃ na phassasukhaṃ na middhasukhaṃ anuyutto viharissāmīti.
an7.61:10.4: sace moggallāna, bhikkhu uccāsoṇḍaṃ paggahetvā kulāni upasaṅkamati, santi hi moggallāna, kulesu kiccakaraṇīyāni
an7.61:10.5: yena manussā āgataṃ bhikkhuṃ na manasikaronti. tatra bhikkhussa evaṃ hoti:
an7.61:10.6: kosudāni maṃ imasmiṃ kule paribhindi. virattarūpādāni me manussāti.
an7.61:10.7: itissa alābhena maṅkubhāvo. maṅkubhūtassa uddhaccaṃ. uddhatassa asaṃvaro. asaṃvutassa ārā cittaṃ samādhimhā.
an7.61:11.4: viggāhikāya moggallāna kathāya sati kathābāhullaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ. kathābāhulle sati uddhaccaṃ. uddhatassa asaṃvaro. asaṃvutassa ārā cittaṃ samādhimhā.
an7.61:11.6: na panāhaṃ moggallāna sabbeheva saṃsaggaṃ na vaṇṇayāmi.
an7.61:11.7: sagahaṭṭhapabbajitehi kho ahaṃ moggallāna saṃsaggaṃ na vaṇṇayāmi.
an7.61:11.8: yāni ca kho tāni senāsanāni appasaddāni appanigghosāni vijanavātāni manussarāhaseyyakāni paṭisallānasāruppāni, tathārūpehi senāsanehi saṃsaggaṃ vaṇṇayāmīti.
an7.61:12.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an7.61:12.2: kittāvatā nu kho bhante, bhikkhu saṅkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutto hoti accantaniṭṭho accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosāno seṭṭho devamanussānanti?
an7.61:13.3: evaṃ cetaṃ moggallāna, bhikkhuno sutaṃ hoti
an7.61:13.5: so sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhijānāti. so sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhiññāya sabbaṃ dhammaṃ parijānāti. sabbaṃ dhammaṃ pariññāya yaṃ kiñci vedanaṃ vediyati sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā,
an7.61:13.6: so tāsu vedanāsu aniccānupassī viharati, virāgānupassī viharati, nirodhānupassī viharati, paṭinissaggānupassī viharati.
an7.61:13.7: so tāsu vedanāsu aniccānupassī viharanto, virāgānupassī viharanto, nirodhānupassī viharanto, paṭinissāggānupassī viharanto na ca kiñci loke upādiyati.
an7.61:13.8: anupādiyaṃ na paritassati. aparitassaṃ paccattaṃyeva parinibbāyati.
an7.61:13.9: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
an7.61:13.10: ettāvatā kho moggallāna, bhikkhu saṅkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutto hoti accantaniṭṭho accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosāno. seṭṭho devamanussānanti.
